author: DarKnight
description: Re-signs idTech 7/8 SaveData files (e.g. DOOM: The Dark Ages) between SteamID64s via a slash command, wrapping mi5hmash's id-savedata-resigner-cli.
install_msg: idsaveresign loaded. Requires .NET 10 runtime on the host (`apt install dotnet-runtime-10.0`) for the bundled resigner binary, and `p7zip-full` if you want .rar upload support.
short: Re-sign DOOM: The Dark Ages saves between SteamIDs via slash command.
